howto.name: Paste SQL
howto.text: Drop a compact SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or JOIN-heavy query into the editor.

howto.name: Review formatted SQL
howto.text: Keywords, clauses, commas, and boolean operators are line-broken into a readable layout.

howto.name: Copy the result
howto.text: Use the formatted SQL in reviews, docs, migrations, dashboards, or database consoles.

faq.q: Is this a full SQL parser?
faq.a: No. It is a lightweight formatter for readable query cleanup. It does not execute, optimize, or validate SQL against a database schema.
No. Formatting happens in browser JavaScript, which is useful for production query snippets and private table names.
Common SELECT, JOIN, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE syntax formats well across Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, and similar dialects.
